description: This file defines the 'BaseRetireHandler' class, which handles the retirement process for objects implementing the 'Retireable' interface within the OpenMRS framework. It includes logic for setting retired status, retire reason, retiring user, and retirement date, with considerations for existing retirement status.

classes.name: BaseRetireHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages the retirement of 'Retireable' objects, setting retired status, reason, user, and date based on certain conditions.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets a 'Retireable' object as retired, including the retired reason, user, and date, applying logic to avoid overwriting existing retirement information.
